title: Evidence view (EvaluationViewManifest + scoped evidence vector)
$comment: Structural residue of the claims.* and evidence.* rules (P0-0/P0-1). evidenceViewId is a sibling of the manifest, not a member of it (evidence.manifest.identity: the id is the digest OF the manifest, so it cannot be inside it). The `scope` enum inlines scope-catalog.json (no cross-file $ref); keep the two in sync. wireVariantId is frozen (P0-4) to wire:v1:jcs-rfc8785:sha256:<64-hex>. One-result-per-scope and the policyDecision/profile required-scope coupling are semantic constraints beyond JSON Schema (claims.coverage.three-value, claims.policy.no-accept-non-verified) and are pinned by vectors.

manifest.$comment: evidence.manifest.identity + evidence.manifest.independent-ids: EvaluationViewManifest committing head, origin-to-head spine (final == head), claim contract, the independent dispatch ids (canonicalizerId, cryptosuiteId, schemaVersion — P0-4 inv7), and input snapshots. It does NOT contain evidenceViewId.

canonicalizerId.$comment: evidence.manifest.independent-ids / canon.jcs.base: the canonicalizer contract id (jcs-rfc8785), recorded independently of the cryptosuite and claim contract.

cryptosuiteId.$comment: evidence.manifest.independent-ids / claims.suite.contract-id: the cryptosuite claim contract id, e.g. W3C_EDDSA_JCS_2022_REC_20250515@1 or LEGACY_PROVIN_EDDSA_JCS_INT64@1.

schemaVersion.$comment: evidence.manifest.independent-ids: the schema version the verdict was evaluated under, recorded independently of the claim contract.

spine.$comment: evidence.manifest.spine: ordered (BodyAddress, WireVariantID) selection, origin-to-head; identity.variant.immutable-set.

inputSnapshotDigests.$comment: claims.verified.definition: digests of the DID / resolver / lifecycle snapshots the verdict depends on.

evidenceViewId.$comment: evidence.manifest.identity: digest OF the manifest (sibling, not member); evidence.cache.exact-view: the sole terminal-verdict cache key.

vector.$comment: claims.coverage.three-value: the scoped evidence vector, one entry per known scope. One-result-per-scope is a semantic constraint (pinned by vector), not expressible here.

versionedId.$comment: A versioned identifier (claim contract / profile), e.g. name@1.

wireVariantId.$comment: identity.wire-variant-id: frozen as wire:v1:jcs-rfc8785:sha256:<64-hex> (P0-4). Digest of the domain tag provin-wire-variant-v1 NUL plus the RFC 8785 canonical wire bytes.

scopeName.$comment: claims.scope.named / claims.catalog.enumerated. Inlined from scope-catalog.json (keep in sync).

allOf.$comment: claims.coverage.three-value: truthState is present exactly when coverage is EVALUATED.

policyDecision.$comment: claims.policy.profile-derived / claims.headline.decision-only: decision derived from a versioned profile, kept separate from evidence. The required-scope coupling (no ACCEPT while a required scope is not VERIFIED) is semantic (claims.policy.no-accept-non-verified), pinned by vector.
